messages.snippet: Maya's passport expires on {{date:2027-01-12|%B %-d, %Y}}. A child renewal needs new photos, a signed form, and an in-person appointment.
messages.body:
Dear Dan Walker,

The passport for Maya Walker expires on {{date:2027-01-12|%B %-d, %Y}}. Children's passports cannot be renewed by mail. To renew, you will need to:

1. Get two new passport photos taken.
2. Complete and sign the child application form, with both parents' signatures.
3. Book an in-person appointment at your local passport office and bring Maya, the old passport, and her birth certificate.

Allow up to eight weeks for processing after your appointment.

Passport Services
